verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Atlas automatically filing one-off formation items, such as the 83(b) election and EIN, but nothing about preparing annual reports or recurring compliance filings. There is also no agent-facing API or delegation mechanism; the openapi probes returned 404 and llms.txt is general Stripe docs. A compliance-filing story is a fair question for an incorporation platform, so the axis applies and the lack of evidence yields none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate an annual report or compliance filing to an agent that prepares it through the platform with minimal human input
